resources.string: Audio recordings and cover artwork are sourced from Osho World and publicly accessible collections on the Internet Archive. All intellectual property rights, including copyrights, trademarks, and rights associated with the Osho name, remain with their respective owners.\n\nRajneesh Discourse is an independent, third-party audio player providing access to publicly available discourse recordings. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, authorized by, or endorsed by the Osho International Foundation, Osho World Foundation, or any other organization associated with Osho.

We respect intellectual property rights and are committed to addressing content-related concerns.

If you believe any audio recording, artwork, or other material infringes your rights, contains incorrect information, or should be removed, please contact us at reports@marfells.com.

When submitting a report, please include:

• The title or link of the content in question.

• A brief description of the concern.

• Supporting details or proof of ownership, if reporting copyright infringement.

We will review submitted reports and take appropriate action, including correcting or removing content when warranted.
